description: This file defines the TransportConf class, which manages configuration settings related to network transport in Apache Spark, including connection timeouts, thread pools, SSL/TLS settings, encryption, and shuffle configurations.

classes.name: TransportConf
classes.description: A class that encapsulates network transport configuration settings for Spark, providing methods to retrieve various network-related parameters and security settings.

methods.name: TransportConf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration keys based on the provided module name and configuration provider.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer configuration value with a default fallback.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a string configuration value with a default fallback.

methods.name: getConfKey
methods.description: Constructs a configuration key string based on the module and suffix.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with this configuration.

methods.name: ioMode
methods.description: Returns the IO mode setting (NIO, EPOLL, KQUEUE, or AUTO).

methods.name: preferDirectBufs
methods.description: Indicates whether off-heap byte buffers are preferred.

methods.name: connectionTimeoutMs
methods.description: Returns the connection idle timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: connectionCreationTimeoutMs
methods.description: Returns the connection creation timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: numConnectionsPerPeer
methods.description: Returns the number of concurrent connections between two nodes.

methods.name: backLog
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of the queue of incoming connections.

methods.name: serverThreads
methods.description: Returns the number of server thread pool threads.

methods.name: clientThreads
methods.description: Returns the number of client thread pool threads.

methods.name: receiveBuf
methods.description: Returns the receive buffer size.

methods.name: sendBuf
methods.description: Returns the send buffer size.

methods.name: authRTTimeoutMs
methods.description: Returns the timeout for a single auth message round trip in milliseconds.

methods.name: maxIORetries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of IO retries per request.

methods.name: ioRetryWaitTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the wait time in milliseconds before retrying after an IOException.

methods.name: memoryMapBytes
methods.description: Returns the minimum block size to use memory mapping.

methods.name: lazyFileDescriptor
methods.description: Indicates whether file descriptors are initialized lazily.

methods.name: verboseMetrics
methods.description: Indicates whether detailed Netty memory metrics are tracked.

methods.name: enableTcpKeepAlive
methods.description: Indicates whether TCP keep-alive is enabled.

methods.name: portMaxRetries
methods.description: Returns the maximum retries for port binding.

methods.name: encryptionEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether encryption is enabled.

methods.name: authEngineVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number for the auth engine.

methods.name: cipherTransformation
methods.description: Returns the cipher transformation string for encryption.

methods.name: saslFallback
methods.description: Indicates whether SASL fallback is enabled.

methods.name: saslEncryption
methods.description: Indicates whether SASL encryption is enabled.

methods.name: maxSaslEncryptedBlockSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of SASL encrypted blocks.

methods.name: saslServerAlwaysEncrypt
methods.description: Indicates whether the server enforces encryption on SASL connections.

methods.name: sslShuffleChunkSize
methods.description: Returns the chunk size for SSL shuffle.

methods.name: sslRpcEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether SSL RPC is enabled.

methods.name: sslRpcProtocol
methods.description: Returns the SSL protocol used for RPC.

methods.name: sslRpcRequestedCiphers
methods.description: Returns the list of requested SSL ciphers.

methods.name: sslRpcKeyStore
methods.description: Returns the SSL keystore file.

methods.name: sslRpcKeyStorePassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the SSL keystore.

methods.name: sslRpcKeyPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the private key.

methods.name: sslRpcPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the private key file for SSL.

methods.name: sslRpcPrivateKeyPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the private key.

methods.name: sslRpcCertChain
methods.description: Returns the SSL certificate chain file.

methods.name: sslRpcTrustStore
methods.description: Returns the trust store file.

methods.name: sslRpcTrustStorePassword
methods.description: Returns the trust store password.

methods.name: sslRpcTrustStoreReloadingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether trust store reloading is enabled.

methods.name: sslRpctrustStoreReloadIntervalMs
methods.description: Returns the trust store reload interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: sslRpcOpenSslEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether OpenSSL is enabled for SSL.

methods.name: sslRpcEnabledAndKeysAreValid
methods.description: Checks if SSL RPC is enabled and the necessary keys/files exist.

methods.name: sharedByteBufAllocators
methods.description: Indicates whether shared ByteBuf allocators are used.

methods.name: preferDirectBufsForSharedByteBufAllocators
methods.description: Indicates whether off-heap buffers are preferred for shared allocators.

methods.name: cryptoConf
methods.description: Returns the crypto configuration properties.

methods.name: maxChunksBeingTransferred
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of chunks allowed to be transferred simultaneously.

methods.name: chunkFetchHandlerThreads
methods.description: Returns the number of threads for handling chunk fetch requests (deprecated).

methods.name: separateChunkFetchRequest
methods.description: Indicates if a separate EventLoopGroup is used for chunk fetch requests (deprecated).

methods.name: finalizeShuffleMergeHandlerThreads
methods.description: Returns the number of threads for handling shuffle merge requests (deprecated).

methods.name: separateFinalizeShuffleMerge
methods.description: Indicates if a separate EventLoopGroup is used for shuffle merge (deprecated).

methods.name: useOldFetchProtocol
methods.description: Indicates whether to use the old shuffle fetch protocol.

methods.name: enableSaslRetries
methods.description: Indicates if SASL retries are enabled.

methods.name: mergedShuffleFileManagerImpl
methods.description: Returns the class name for the merged shuffle file manager implementation.

methods.name: minChunkSizeInMergedShuffleFile
methods.description: Returns the minimum chunk size for merged shuffle files.

methods.name: mergedIndexCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the merged index cache.

methods.name: ioExceptionsThresholdDuringMerge
methods.description: Returns the threshold for IOExceptions during shuffle merge.

methods.name: mergedShuffleCleanerShutdownTimeout
methods.description: Returns the shutdown timeout for the shuffle cleaner.
